IMPLEMENTATION (render-only): constants STALE_MEMORY_DAYS=7 + STALE_MEMORY_PREFIX='⏳[可能陈旧] ' (after SIMILARITY_UPDATE). private static #stalenessPrefix(m: DeserializedMemory, now): age from CAMELCASE m.updatedAt (fallback m.lastAccessedAt), explicit Number.isNaN guard → '' for invalid/missing timestamp (unknown-age NOT annotated, no throw); ageDays > 7 → STALE_MEMORY_PREFIX else ''. toPromptSection builder inserts prefix BETWEEN badge and [type]: `- ${badge} ${stale}[${m.type}] ${m.content}`; fresh memories (stale='') byte-identical to before; signature/return Promise<string> unchanged.

CAMELCASE LOAD-BEARING TRAP FIX (design §3/§8): builder feeds DeserializedMemory (MemoryStore.deserialize → camelCase updatedAt/lastAccessedAt); raw-row snake_case m.updated_at would be new Date(undefined)=NaN → every memory silently un-annotated (phase ships as a no-op). #stalenessPrefix reads ONLY camelCase; DeserializedMemory has no snake keys so misuse fails build:check (verified exit 0 with camelCase). The 3 PRE-EXISTING snake_case sites in MemoryRetriever (:132/:255/:261) operate on raw MemoryRow and are NOT touched.

CG-1 FULL SOURCE: builder change is source-agnostic (no branch on source), covering both bootstrap (insightAnalyst:391) and user (MemoryCoordinator:799) recall paths.

UNIT TESTS (+4) — fixtures via the REAL store.add → getAllActive/deserialize path (NOT hand-built camelCase literals, so casing drift goes red), aged via raw-row UPDATE semantic_memories SET updated_at/last_accessed_at; MemoryRetriever imported via DIRECT path (not barrel — not exported from src/index.ts): (1) >7d (30d) → annotated (regex /⏳\\[可能陈旧\\] \\[.*\\] STALE_ITEM/); (2) ≤7d (1d) → NOT annotated; (3) missing/invalid timestamp (updated_at='' + last_accessed_at=null) → unknown-age NOT annotated (NaN guard); (4) updatedAt empty + lastAccessedAt set → falls back to lastAccessedAt via real deserialize → annotated.
